format: Perl (assembly code generation for cryptographic operations)
description: This file contains Perl scripts that generate x86 assembly routines for big number multiplication and squaring using the Comba method, specifically for the BN (big number) module in cryptography. It defines functions for multi-precision multiplication and squaring, including low-level assembly code for optimized arithmetic operations.

methods.name: mul_add_c
methods.description: Performs a partial multiplication and addition of big number limbs, used internally in the Comba multiplication routines.

methods.name: sqr_add_c
methods.description: Performs a partial squaring operation for equal limbs, used internally in the Comba squaring routines.

methods.name: sqr_add_c2
methods.description: Performs a specialized partial squaring operation for different limbs, used internally in the Comba squaring routines.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba
methods.description: Generates assembly code for multi-precision multiplication using the Comba method for a specified number of limbs.

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba
methods.description: Generates assembly code for multi-precision squaring using the Comba method for a specified number of limbs.
